description: This file is a build script designed to automate the cloning, configuration, and installation of various CCSP components and related tools. It uses git for cloning repositories, autoreconf and configure scripts for setting up build environments, and make for compilation. The script is parameterized by a username and component name to selectively build and install specific components.

methods.name: execute_component
methods.description: Main function that takes user input to clone, configure, compile, and install specified CCSP components based on the provided component name.

search-terms: shell script build system for CCSP components
